models.codex_bridge_thread_model_label: gpt-6.1-sol; local EVA provider, not an extra upstream model request

installed_codex_default.caveat: Defaults can be overridden; no model-weight or account-active-route equivalence proven.

official_sources.finding: Current desktop ChatGPT Voice is powered by GPT-Live; task-selected backend carries out requests.
Full-duplex listening/speaking, with reasoning/tools delegated to a backend.
GPT-Live supports an existing backend; this differs from a single Realtime reasoning/voice model.

models.conclusion: Same configured default identifier as the new installed Codex voice route and same documented GPT-Live family. Exact parity with the separate installed Classic app or backend weights remains unverified.

historical_trial.timing_correction: REPLY_COMMITTED.data.model_timing.completed_ms is 8309. The earlier roughly 6-second model journal admission/completion interval is not the whole request latency.
historical_trial.connection_gap_boundary: Remote SDP answer received to provider session.started; historical ICE/DTLS/data-channel times absent, so exact cause cannot be reconstructed.

new_full_trial.output_measurement: First >80 PCM amplitude frame handed into SpeakerAudioOutput for the forecast turn, not a physical acoustic measurement.
new_full_trial.caveat: Unchanged production logic with observation hooks. Different timing is variability, not demonstrated optimization.

standby_candidate_preparation.finding: Two ICE transports enumerate host interfaces. Successful STUN candidates arrive around 2.49-2.56 s; remaining requests wait until the approximately 5-second gather timeout. Preparation is normally before wake, outside the old 12.957-second interval.

browser_settings_experiment.outcome: failed; remained ICE checking and timed out waiting for session.started after 15 s
browser_settings_experiment.caveat: Two settings changed together; this does not isolate which setting or combination caused failure.

connection_audit.desktop_comparison: Installed browser code constructs RTCPeerConnection without explicit STUN; shared voice code uses max-bundle and prewarming. Python aiortc defaults include Google STUN. Browser and Python defaults are not equivalent.

isolated_research_profile.transport_behavior: open_research_response buffers all SSE bytes before parsing/validating and releasing the durable result. First text is not forwarded to voice.
isolated_research_profile.prompt_behavior: Existing generic research instructions ask for a standalone Dutch Markdown research document, primary sources, facts/inference distinctions, limitations and conclusion. They also ask to stop once a reliable answer is found. This is heavier than a concise spoken factual answer.
isolated_research_profile.limit: Cannot separate provider model computation, remote scheduling and individual web-service time beyond observed SSE event boundaries.

component_review.component: Home Assistant wake and device admission
component_review.finding: The production wrapper opens the household return session and begins device capture before media.start. The synthetic fixture preopens that session. These physical wake/admission intervals were not included or acoustically measured.
Cached PCM, starts without a model call; actual speaker duration not inferred from simulated FINISHED acknowledgement.
16 kHz input is resampled to 48 kHz / 20 ms frames. Speech during startup is retained then sent at real-time pace; only quiet backlog is skipped. No separate STT model call.
GPT-Live sends delegation while the question is finishing, with a short acknowledgement. No fixed 12-second sleep in the media path.
Local Responses provider to existing household core. About 0.466 s in the new probe; not a hidden extra remote Sol request. Bridge waits for final core reply and ignores provisional deltas.

Initial scoped Hindsight retrieval blocks before the contact model. Active work context is read in parallel. The private-person 30-second fast cache does not apply to household audience; measured 2.383/2.751 s. No foreground reflection loop found.
Installed gpt-6-sol / none decides and admits research. One recorded model attempt, not repeated model retries. 8.309 s historical / 4.186 s new recorded model latency.
Durable background admission; worker poll default 0.25 s. created_at is turn time, not insertion time. No evidence of the previously alleged 12-second worker queue.
Astra medium, 2-3 web actions, followed by document generation and full-result validation. 17/23 s full trials; isolated detailed trial 16.67 s.

Polling every 2 seconds plus HTTP and scoped authorization. New poll took 0.521 s and first authorization 0.199 s. Foreground completion is prioritized, but foreground had finished long before this result.

Same live voice session receives appendSpeech; it reformulates the saved text. New signal reached speaker sink 1.073 s after offer, including 0.299 s after provider turn event. 48 kHz decoded audio resampled to 24 kHz; native wire uses 20 ms chunks and a four-chunk acknowledgement window. No fresh TTS model or voice session on result return.
Echo cancellation, actual hardware buffering, audible completeness and interruption quality cannot be validated by simulated speaker receipts.

priorities: Keep content-free ICE/transport/data-channel timestamps for a recurrence of the 11.431-second startup gap; do not label the outlier fixed.
Reduce unnecessary network interface candidate work while retaining working NAT traversal; browser-settings experiment failed and must not be deployed.
Give short public factual requests a concise, source-grounded output through the existing EVA authority and work model, instead of always producing a research document.
Review whether short research can return on its original delegation without an extra background handoff/poll, while preserving durable task ownership and cancellation.
Optimize scoped memory and repeated authorization/storage overhead using measurements; do not bypass memory or publish unvalidated partial research.
